steps.title: Split eluate
steps.instruction: Divide the 40 µL eluate into two aliquots of 20 µL each.

steps.title: Shear DNA
steps.instruction: Shear 3–5 µg DNA in 100 µL to ~2 kb using a Diagenode Bioruptor Pico: 5 cycles, 4 s on / 30 s off.

steps.title: Split sheared DNA
steps.instruction: Split the sheared DNA into two reactions to maximize reaction efficacy.

steps.title: Mix reaction components
steps.instruction: Add the specified components (as listed in the original protocol) to a sterile, nuclease‑free tube and mix.

steps.title: Combine reactions
steps.instruction: Combine the two reactions together in preparation for AMPure XP cleanup.

steps.title: Thermocycler incubation 1
steps.instruction: Incubate in a thermocycler: 30 min at 20 °C, then 30 min at 65 °C, then hold at 4 °C (total 1 h).

steps.title: Add AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Add 65 µL AMPure XP beads (1 × v/v ratio) at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with beads
steps.instruction: Incubate for 5 min at room temperature to allow DNA binding.

steps.title: Magnetic separation
steps.instruction: Spin briefly in a minifuge, place tube on a magnetic rack until beads separate from the solution.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on the magnetic rack, add 200 µL of 70 % ethanol (in nuclease‑free water) without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Incubate ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Incubate for at least 30 s at room temperature.

steps.title: Repeat ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Repeat the magnetic separation, supernatant removal, and 70 % ethanol wash steps for a total of two washes, then remove the final supernatant.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Spin briefly in a minifuge to pellet residual ethanol, keep on the magnetic rack, and remove remaining ethanol with a P10 pipette.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 27 µL nuclease‑free water (25 µL + 2 µL to compensate for transfer loss).

steps.title: Elution incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Separate eluate
steps.instruction: Spin briefly, place on magnetic rack, and retain the supernatant containing the eluted DNA.

steps.title: Thermocycler incubation 2
steps.instruction: Incubate the eluate in a thermocycler at 20 °C for 15 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pause and store
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol if needed and store the library at –20 °C.

steps.title: AMPure cleanup 1.8X
steps.instruction: Purify the adapted DNA with 1.8 × AMPure XP beads (v/v) and elute in 32 µL nuclease‑free water (follow standard AMPure cleanup).

steps.title: High‑pass size selection
steps.instruction: Perform size selection using a 0.75 % cassette high‑pass protocol (estimated 45 min).

steps.title: Post‑elution incubation
steps.instruction: Let the sample sit for approximately 45 min after elution for optimal recovery.

steps.title: AMPure cleanup 1X (first)
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA with 1 × AMPure XP beads (v/v) and elute in 15 µL nuclease‑free water (follow standard AMPure cleanup).

steps.title: Prepare RNase block
steps.instruction: Dilute RNase block 1:10 with nuclease‑free water to make a blocking solution; use 7 µL per reaction.

steps.title: Add gDNA to block mix
steps.instruction: In a strip tube, combine 3.4 µL genomic DNA with 5.6 µL SureSelect block mix.

steps.title: Denature DNA
steps.instruction: Mix by pipetting, then denature in a thermocycler: 95 °C for 5 min, followed by 65 °C for at least 5 min.

steps.title: Hybridization incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 16 or 24 h at 65 °C with a heated lid set to 105 °C.

steps.title: Prepare streptavidin beads
steps.instruction: Vigorously resuspend MyOne Streptavidin T1 beads on a vortex mixer.

steps.title: Add beads to tube
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL beads (per reaction) to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Add binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL SureSelect Binding buffer to the beads.

steps.title: Mix beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the beads for 5 seconds to mix.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash beads (3×)
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 200 µL SureSelect Binding buffer, vortex 5 s, and discard supernatant for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Resuspend in XT buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed beads in 200 µL SureSelectXT Binding buffer.

steps.title: Add hybridization mixture
steps.instruction: Transfer the hybridization mixture directly to the bead suspension, invert 3–5 times to mix; note that <20 µL remaining may reduce capture efficiency.

steps.title: Hybrid‑bait incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead‑bait mixture on a tube rotator at 10 rpm (top‑to‑bottom) for 30 min at room temperature; if mixing is poor, use a thermomixer at 30 °C, 800 rpm.

steps.title: Magnetic capture
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: First wash buffer I
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 500 µL Wash Buffer I and vortex for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate wash I
steps.instruction: Incubate for 15 min at room temperature, mixing occasionally.

steps.title: Remove wash I
steps.instruction: Spin briefly, place on magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second wash buffer (65 °C)
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 200 µL pre‑warmed (65 °C) Wash Buffer, vortex for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate wash II
steps.instruction: Incubate for 10 min at 65 °C.

steps.title: Repeat washes (total 3)
steps.instruction: Spin briefly, place on magnetic rack, discard supernatant, and repeat the 65 °C wash step for a total of three washes.

steps.title: Final ethanol removal
steps.instruction: Remove all remaining wash buffer.

steps.title: Resuspend in water
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL nuclease‑free water to each sample, pipet to resuspend, and keep on ice until further use.

steps.title: End‑repair/dA‑tailing
steps.instruction: Assemble PCR reactions (two per capture reaction) and perform NEBNext Ultra II End‑Repair/dA‑tailing in a 60 µL volume.

steps.title: AMPure cleanup post‑repair
steps.instruction: Purify the reaction with 1 × AMPure XP beads and elute in 30 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: AMPure cleanup after ligation
steps.instruction: Purify the adaptor‑ligated DNA with 1 × AMPure XP beads and elute in 30 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Final adaptor‑ligated DNA cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the adaptor‑ligated DNA according to the protocol’s specifications.

steps.title: Load MinION flowcell
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto an ONT MinION flowcell following the manufacturer’s protocol and sequence for up to 48 hours.
